_comment: Fire-elemental aura (2026-07-21): the burn field both elementals carry — a fire dot on EVERYONE hostile in range (selector 'all', KoboldVolley precedent), because the elemental damages what stands near it rather than picking a target. Shared by FireElemental (cL18) and GreaterFireElemental (cL20) by PO ruling: the elite's extra HP and damage come from its tier baseline + f(cL), not from a separate skill. Curve-position-1 baseline.
